+# Evidence report
+
+Question: official method for updating an already routed GW5AST-138 BSRAM/ITCM or AE350 boot ROM image without repeating synthesis/PnR.
+
+Findings from the examined excerpts:
+
+- GW5AST-138 BSRAM content is handled during bitstream generation. SUG100 (PDF pp. 55-56, printed pp. 43-44) documents Print BSRAM Initial Value for GW5A(S)(T)-138/GW5AT-75, with default (all locations) or partial (used columns) modes when MSPI JUMP or Multi Boot is quad. SUG1220 (PDF pp. 58-59, printed pp. 51-52) documents `-bit_incl_bsram_init` and `-bsram_init_print_mode` for the same restriction. This is a generation option, not evidence of a standalone patcher for an already produced bitstream.
+
+- The only documented post-routing update path in the excerpts is Gowin_PicoRV32 software/ITCM merging. It needs a .posp containing only BSRAM placement. SUG100 (PDF p. 48, printed p. 36) and SUG1220 (PDF p. 40, printed p. 33) document generating that file: GUI Place & Route > General > Generate Post-Place File, or `set_option -gen_posp 1`; default is off. IPUG913 (PDF pp. 14-15, printed pp. 7-8) gives the exact merge command `merge_bit.exe bin-file fs-file itcm_size posp-file` and requires the post-place file. The guide supports LittleBee, Arora, and Arora V families only (PDF p. 18, printed p. 11).
+
+- AE350 is different: MUG1031 (PDF pp. 28, 38, printed pp. 20, 30) documents ITCM as an optional instruction memory with configurable size, default disabled and SPI Flash instruction memory enabled; initialization uses hexadecimal ITCM files generated through the make_hex tool. It does not document .posp generation, merge_bit, or any post-route update method in the examined scope. IPUG913 also does not extend merge_bit to AE350.
+
+Practical conclusion:
+
+For a parent design whose outputs include .fs, .vo, .pr, and .p but no .posp, the documented merge_bit workflow cannot be followed as-is; generation of .posp requires Place & Route to be rerun with the option enabled or a new build. The .fs regeneration path remains necessary for GW5AST-138 BSRAM initial-value changes. No documented AE350 post-routing shortcut was found in the examined pages. This is an absence in the examined scope, not proof of impossibility in all manual versions. Distinguish Gowin_PicoRV32 assumptions from AE350 or GW5AST-138; verify device/IP family before using any of these commands.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Read-only evidence extractor for GW5AST-138/AE350 BSRAM/ITCM update documentation."""
+import argparse, hashlib, json, re, sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+SOURCES = {
+    "SUG100_excerpts.txt": "SUG100",
+    "SUG1220_excerpts.txt": "SUG1220",
+    "MUG1031_excerpts.txt": "MUG1031",
+    "IPUG913_excerpts.txt": "IPUG913",
+}
+ALIASES = {
+    "claim": ("claim", "text", "statement", "finding", "result", "description"),
+    "source": ("source", "source_file", "file", "document", "manual", "src"),
+    "pdf_page": ("pdf_page", "pdfpage", "pdf", "page", "page_pdf"),
+    "printed_page": ("printed_page", "printedpage", "printed", "document_page", "print_page"),
+    "limitation": ("limitation", "caveat", "limit", "scope", "note", "boundary"),
+}
+KEY_TERMS = [
+    "merge_bit", "gen_posp", ".posp", "AE350", "GW5A(S)(T)-138", "ITCM", "BSRAM",
+    "bit_incl_bsram_init", "bsram_init_print_mode", "make_hex", "Post-Place File",
+]
+
+
+def sha256_file(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as f:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
+            h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def split_pages(text):
+    out = {}
+    for part in re.split(r"(?===== PDF page )", text):
+        m = re.search(r"PDF page (\d+),", part)
+        if m:
+            out[int(m.group(1))] = part
+    return out
+
+
+def printed_page(block):
+    ms = re.findall(r"(\d+)\((\d+)\)", block)
+    if not ms:
+        return None, None
+    n, total = ms[-1]
+    return int(n), int(total)
+
+
+def norm_key(k):
+    return re.sub(r"[\s_\-]+", "", str(k)).lower()
+
+
+def field(entry, name):
+    wanted = {norm_key(x) for x in ALIASES[name]}
+    for k, v in entry.items():
+        if norm_key(k) in wanted:
+            return v
+    return None
+
+
+def load_claims(path):
+    data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
+    if isinstance(data, list):
+        return data
+    for key in ("claims", "findings", "evidence", "results", "entries"):
+        if isinstance(data.get(key), list):
+            return data[key]
+    raise ValueError("findings.json contains no claim list")
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Validate and summarize manual evidence")
+    parser.add_argument("--findings", default="findings.json")
+    parser.add_argument("--search", help="extra term to locate in excerpts")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    expected = json.loads(Path("source_sha.json").read_text())
+    blocks = {}
+    for source, code in SOURCES.items():
+        p = Path(source)
+        if not p.is_file():
+            raise SystemExit(f"missing source: {source}")
+        actual = sha256_file(p)
+        if expected.get(source) and actual != expected[source]:
+            raise SystemExit(f"SHA mismatch for {source}")
+        blocks[source] = split_pages(p.read_text())
+
+    claims = load_claims(args.findings)
+    errors = []
+    for i, entry in enumerate(claims, 1):
+        source = field(entry, "source")
+        if source not in blocks:
+            errors.append(f"claim {i}: unknown source {source!r}")
+            continue
+        try:
+            pdf = int(field(entry, "pdf_page"))
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            errors.append(f"claim {i}: missing/invalid pdf_page")
+            continue
+        if pdf not in blocks[source]:
+            errors.append(f"claim {i}: PDF page {pdf} not found in {source}")
+            continue
+        page_text = blocks[source][pdf]
+        printed = field(entry, "printed_page")
+        actual_printed, _ = printed_page(page_text)
+        if printed is not None and actual_printed is not None and int(printed) != actual_printed:
+            errors.append(f"claim {i}: printed page {printed} != actual {actual_printed}")
+            continue
+        if not field(entry, "claim"):
+            errors.append(f"claim {i}: missing claim text")
+            continue
+        if not field(entry, "limitation"):
+            errors.append(f"claim {i}: missing limitation")
+            continue
+
+    if errors:
+        for e in errors:
+            print(e)
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+    terms = list(KEY_TERMS)
+    if args.search:
+        terms.append(args.search)
+    print("Term/page occurrences (case-insensitive):")
+    for term in terms:
+        hits = []
+        for source in sorted(blocks):
+            for pdf in sorted(blocks[source]):
+                if term.lower() in blocks[source][pdf].lower():
+                    printed, _ = printed_page(blocks[source][pdf])
+                    suffix = f" (printed p.{printed})" if printed else ""
+                    hits.append(f"{source} PDF p.{pdf}{suffix}")
+        if hits:
+            print(f"  {term}: " + "; ".join(hits))
+        else:
+            print(f"  {term}: not found in examined scope")
+
+    sources_ok = len(blocks)
+    print(f"Evidence summary: sources={sources_ok} SHA-verified; claims={len(claims)} validated; term occurrences reported above.")
+    print("Summary: all cited sources/PDF pages and printed pages validated successfully.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
